definitions.explanation: The system of formal and polite expressions in Japanese used to show respect to others or humility about oneself.

examples.japanese: {敬語|けいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to use honorific language correctly.
Speak to superiors using honorific language.

examples.japanese: {敬語|けいご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Being skilled at honorific language makes a good impression.

notes:
TYPES OF KEIGO:
- ⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧ (honorific language - elevates the listener/subject)
- ⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧ (humble language - lowers the speaker)
- ⟦{丁寧語|ていねいご}→丁寧語：15824_teineigo⟧ (polite language - です/ます forms)

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → ⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧ (honorific), ⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (humble)
- ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ → ⟦おっしゃる→おっしゃる：01299_ossharu⟧ (honorific), ⟦{申|もう}す→申す：01319_mousu⟧ (humble)
- ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ → ⟦いらっしゃる→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧ (honorific), ⟦{参|まい}る→参る：01322_mairu⟧ (humble)

USAGE: Essential in Japanese business, service industry, and formal social interactions. Many Japanese people struggle with keigo even as adults.
